description: This Java source file defines the QuickTextKeysBrowseFragment class, which extends AbstractAddOnsBrowserFragment to provide a UI component for browsing and managing quick text key addons within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles initialization, cleanup, applying addons to demo keyboards, and navigation to settings.

classes.name: QuickTextKeysBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment class for browsing and managing quick text key addons, extending AbstractAddOnsBrowserFragment with specific implementations for quick text keys.
